description: Historical public-filing replay, March 2023 to August 2024, against the August 2021 Oaktree term loan. Reports are SEC-filed company disclosures revealed on the dates the SEC accepted them. Lender responses are the actual amendments: Amendment No. 5 from its clean SEC-filed text, Amendment No. 8 from the company's Form 10-Q description.
